en: Hi! I'm Whitney! Everyone was into Pokémon, so I got into them too. They're just so cute!
You want to battle? I'm warning you, I'm good!
Sob... Waaaaah! You're so mean! Picking on me like that...
Whitney is crying too hard to say anything more...
...Sniff... Sorry about that. I just hate losing!
Oh, right, the Badge. You won it fair and square. Here's the Plain Badge!
{player} received the Plain Badge from Whitney!
With it, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Strength outside of battle.
And this is for you too. It's my favourite move!
TM45 is Attract. It makes a Pokémon of the other gender fall for yours, so it hardly fights back. Isn't that cute?
Ah, that was fun! Even though I lost. Come and battle me again when you're stronger. I'll be stronger too!
Yo, future Champion! Whitney's Pokémon are Normal types. They look cute, but they hit hard.
Her Miltank is the one to watch. It can roll right over a team. Fighting moves are your best bet!
You beat Whitney! Did she cry? She always cries. Don't worry, she'll be fine in a minute.
